pinMinLength: PIN must be at least 4 digits
pinMismatch: PINs do not match. Please try again.
biometricLockEnabledDesc: App will lock when sent to background
biometricAvailableHint: Use fingerprint or face to unlock the app when it returns from background.

disabledAIsEmptyHint: AIs you disable will appear here. You can enable them anytime.
voiceInputUnavailable: Connect to Soulbits Engine to set up voice input.
hideContentOnLockScreenDesc: Show a generic alert instead of the message preview.
transportSectionDesc: Choose how Soulbits delivers message alerts from your AI companions.
transportAutoDesc: Use the fastest available path — a directly connected engine first, otherwise the cloud when you're signed in.
transportDirectDesc: Deliver through your own engine/device. Requires a direct connection.
transportCloudDesc: Relay through Soulbits Cloud when you're signed in.
transportOffDesc: No message alerts, in-app or on the lock screen.
transportConvenienceNote: Cloud delivery is a convenience when you're signed in — it's never required.
